inputs.prompt: Create a single full-body manga character sprite: A manga office worker with long dark brown hair, amber eyes, a navy blazer, white shirt, and ID badge. Standing, facing the viewer, entire head and feet visible, clean linework, consistent anime shading. Isolated on a transparent background, no text.

Close-up portrait of this exact character's face and shoulders, smiling warmly with a cheerful, happy expression. Keep the same character: identical face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color and outfit. Preserve the reference image's manga illustration style. Clean white background.
